02 / About

How I work.

Approach

I build programs around the distinctions that change their behavior, so new cases are handled by the model rather than added as exceptions.

Process

I test a premise through the consequences it produces, using their direction to decide whether the premise should continue shaping the work.

Constraint

I fit each program to the work it must do, with every additional layer justified by a demand that work actually creates.
